WHAT: Vinted's `search_by_image_uuid` API endpoint accepts and correctly applies `size_ids` and `color_ids` filter params
WHERE: /api/v2/catalog/items?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid>&size_ids[]=<id>
HOW: Test confirmed — with size filter all results are size L, without filter results are M and S
WHY RESULTS SUCK: We're cropping small fragments of outfit photos (e.g., just the polo area with arms + background) and uploading those crops. Vinted's CLIP model expects clean product-style images, not partial outfit crops. The model returns any polo, not specifically white ones.
FIX OPTIONS:
1. Upload full outfit photo once → one UUID → use text filters (size, color, brand, catalog) per item
2. Drop image search entirely, use tuned text search which already works better
GOTCHA: Docker container wasn't rebuilding during debug — new code didn't take effect, logs showed old format
